objective: Test whether a maximum 2 mm micro-adjustment of the forefoot sensor closes the residual heel-to-forefoot support gap without changing the simple two-sensor architecture, production FSM, thresholds, dwell, contact law, or sealed data. Freeze H2 and F70 from the formal V1 physical-continuity result, evaluate P30.0-P32.0 at 10 ms, choose only the shallowest full physical+V3 pass, and confirm that pair plus the current comparator at 1 ms.

common_cycle_audit.policy: exclude one common right-boundary cycle set using dwell plus the primary 10 ms margin, then reuse it at both cadences

reference_provenance.boundary_policy: only complete HS-to-HS cycles; the contact already active at t_start and the open contact at t_end are boundary-censored

reference_definition.rule: stance on each accepted reference HS-to-TO interval; swing on each accepted TO-to-HS interval

boundary_policy.reason: the prescribed stance already active at t_start has no observable HS inside the replay and production performs a partial-stance bootstrap

mismatch_policy.rule: inside the strict interval, mismatches are allowed only in windows derived from the fixed HS/TO timing tolerance and the configured causal sensor dwell

regional_continuity.contact_definition: production FSM debounced regional sensor latch
regional_continuity.transition_sign_convention: heel_off_to_toe_on_signed_s > 0 is unsupported gap; < 0 is overlap

primary_10ms.continuity_helper_role_override: regional continuity metrics are gating in this V2 protocol, despite the imported V1 helper's historical diagnostic label

interpretation_limits: V2 is development because the same already-open 50-100 s block informed and evaluates the micro-grid.
The imported regional-continuity helper historically labels its output diagnostic-only; this V2 protocol explicitly promotes the frozen continuity checks to a preregistered physical pre-gate.
A 10 ms failure cannot be rescued by 1 ms. If no strict 10 ms winner exists, no 1 ms run or diagnostic winner is produced.
The shallowest full pass is preferred; deeper force or overlap is not optimized.
Passing V2 does not promote a detector profile and does not validate policy robustness, hardware sensors, another subject, or the sealed 100-155.045 s block.
No policy/training, runtime profile, threshold, dwell, contact law, or FSM is modified.
